fields.Name: Skip ICF - Committee Governance Drill-Down
fields.Description: Committee -> meetings -> motions/votes three-level drill-down over Committees: Committees / Meetings / Attendances / Motions / Votes.

InputDefinition.userMessage: Create a committee governance report: a chart of each committee with its number of meetings, average attendance rate and number of motions. Let me click a committee to see its meetings over time with attendance. Then let me click a meeting to see the motions voted on, with yes/no/abstain counts and how each member voted. [NO CHAT]

judgeValidationCriteria: Response includes a chart of all six committees with meeting count, attendance rate and motion count
Attendance rate is based on Committees: Attendances (Present vs Absent/Excused), roughly 71-75% for each committee
Clicking a committee shows its meetings over time with attendance
Clicking a meeting shows its motions with result and Yes/No/Abstain counts, and individual votes
Three levels of drill-down work with clear context (titles/breadcrumbs)
Final rows can open the meeting, motion or member record
